deviations.relative_to_tags: after wp6-prereg, before wp6-generator-freeze and wp6-run-freeze
deviations.what: `wp6/runner.py` re-implements the orchestration loop of `wp5.runner.run_all` instead of calling it. Everything else is reused unchanged (`agent.run_agent`, `conditions.condition_text`, `evaluate.evaluate_diff`, `ledgers` format, `runner.ensure_env/schedule/is_infra/load_valid`). `wp5/*` is untouched.
deviations.why: The venv reset has to happen inside the per-task loop, which in `wp5.runner` is a closure that cannot be hooked without editing frozen WP5 code.
deviations.expected_impact: None on behaviour; same schedule rule, retries and checkpoints.

deviations.relative_to_tags: after wp6-prereg, before wp6-generator-freeze and wp6-run-freeze
deviations.what: The venv reset is done by restoring a pristine copy of the freshly built venv (`.v_golden`, same absolute path) and clearing the agent's `HOME`, **before every agent run and again before the evaluation of that run's patch**. `uv pip freeze` is hashed before and after each agent episode (Y7). The design text says "hash and rebuild after any change"; the coordinator decision says "reset before every run"; both are done (reset always, hash for Y7).
deviations.why: Coordinator decision; copying is seconds, rebuilding is 20 to 90 s per run (about 25 % more wall time). Evaluating in the pristine venv means a package that only the agent installed cannot make a patch pass or fail.
deviations.expected_impact: In WP5 the evaluation ran in the (possibly mutated) shared venv; WP6 resolve rates are therefore evaluated under the same environment for every run.

deviations.relative_to_tags: after wp6-prereg, before wp6-generator-freeze and wp6-run-freeze
deviations.what: A false dependency line carries **no version specifier** (`httpx`, not `httpx>=...`); true lines keep the declared specifier verbatim.
deviations.why: Design 2.2 gives no specifier for the competitor. Copying the replaced dependency's specifier produced nonsense such as `toolz^0.109.2`.
deviations.expected_impact: The length of F lines differs by a few characters; a bare name is also a valid T line (unversioned declarations exist).

deviations.relative_to_tags: after wp6-prereg, before wp6-generator-freeze and wp6-run-freeze
deviations.what: *(finding, needs a decision)* The WP5 tasks are small repositories, so the T manifests are far shorter than the design estimate (median 299 characters and 11 claims, against 1.0 to 1.6 k and 19), and **a falsification slot can often not be filled**. Rule applied as designed: an unfillable slot is dropped from **all** manifests of the task. Result for the 80 tasks (superseded by deviation 13): kind 1 filled in 34, kind 2 in 29, kind 3 in 34, kind 4 in 43; mean false claims per F manifest 1.75 (0: 14 tasks, 1: 25, 2: 16, 3: 17, 4: 8); in 14 tasks F_R and F_I equal T. Causes: no non-gold, non-test layout entry (45 tasks), fewer than 3 key-file directories (51), no true test command (33: `pytest --collect-only <root>` rc 2 in 17 tasks because a few test modules fail to import and rc 3 or 5 in 2; pytest signature not supported in 12 by the re-check and in 1 by HermiT, entry 8; no test root in 1), no declared dependency imported by a non-test file (27) or none outside the gold files (10), a `make` target that the checker cannot contradict (14). 30 of 80 tasks exceed the 5 % length rule (`length_violation_*`, covariate SA4).
deviations.why: The 4-of-19 dose is a deliberate coordinator decision; the implementation cannot reach it on these repositories.
deviations.expected_impact: The dose varies from 0 to 4 per task. H1 to H4 have less power than designed; `n_false` and `kind` must enter the analysis as covariates, or the rule must change (options in the final report). No code path was changed to hide it.

deviations.relative_to_tags: after wp6-prereg, before wp6-generator-freeze and wp6-run-freeze
deviations.what: *(note)* Operational definitions where the design is silent: **package directory** = a directory with at least one non-test source module of its own (excluding `MODULE_ROOT_EXCLUDED` names and hidden/egg-info directories); **gold area** = directories that contain a gold-touched file, so an **unrelated** layout entry is one with no gold file under it; **gold package** for F_I's removed file = the depth-1 component of the gold directories; **test root** = the shallowest ancestor named test/tests/testing of the most test files (else the repository root); **key files** rank the listed non-test directories by number of source modules in the subtree and take the largest file of each (no file twice); **runtime dependencies** = declared Python distributions that are installed in the task venv and imported by at least one non-test source file outside `MODULE_ROOT_EXCLUDED` (deny list in `wp6.yaml`: python, pip, setuptools, wheel, build backends), ranked by importing files; import names come from the venv's distribution metadata; **Python line** = `>=` lower bound of `requires-python` / `python_requires` (or `^`/`~` bound), kept only if the re-check says Supported.
deviations.why: Needed to make the generator mechanical.
deviations.expected_impact: Layout, key-file and dependency choices are deterministic given the base tree and the pinned task venv.

deviations.relative_to_tags: after wp6-prereg, before wp6-generator-freeze and wp6-run-freeze
deviations.what: *(note)* Extra uniqueness constraints: the make-target regex must also have zero `git grep` hits in the base tree (a README line "make test" would make a hit unattributable); a fake dependency must additionally be absent from the declared dependencies; every false token is audited after generation (`token_audit` in the manifests index: 280 tokens, 0 failing). Path names are checked against path components and the issue text; they are not required to be absent from file contents (the vocabulary words `core`, `internal`, ... occur in many files, so counterfactual T/A hits are expected and are what the counterfactual baseline measures).
deviations.why: Design 2.2 constraints, applied literally and one step further for commands.

deviations.relative_to_tags: after wp6-prereg, before wp6-generator-freeze and wp6-run-freeze
deviations.what: *(note)* Verification split over two venvs: the generator, the re-check (instrument 2) and the runtime probes run in the WP5 run venv; HermiT (instrument 1, owlready2) runs in the project venv (`wp6/hermit_worker.py`, reads the measured claims as JSON and builds the ABox). **One ABox per task** holds the union of the distinct claims of T, F_R and F_I (a claim's verdict does not depend on the manifest it sits in), not one per manifest.
deviations.why: owlready2 is not installed in the run venv.

deviations.relative_to_tags: after wp6-prereg, before wp6-generator-freeze and wp6-run-freeze
deviations.what: Gate-driven rejection: in the first full pass **one claim of 1,069** disagreed between the instruments: `maxhumber__gif-17`, true claim `T3\|test_framework\|pytest` was `Contradicted` (`ToolAbsentInEcosystem`) by HermiT and `Supported` by the re-check. The test-command line was dropped for that task (`wp6_rejects.json`, regenerated; flag `no_test_command`, kind 3 dropped). After that: 1,068 of 1,068 claims pass, instrument agreement 1.0.
deviations.expected_impact: One more task without a kind-3 slot; the disagreement is a genuine second-application finding about the RQ2 checker (one in 1,069 claims).

deviations.relative_to_tags: after wp6-prereg, before wp6-generator-freeze and wp6-run-freeze
deviations.what: Sample manifests for all 80 tasks and the verification report were generated **before the tag `wp6-generator-freeze` exists** (generator development used the six development tasks; the full generation and the pilot were requested together). The first full generation was stopped after about 25 tasks to add the token audit and regenerated from scratch; no manifest from the stopped pass is kept.
deviations.expected_impact: The generator must be frozen (tag) after review and before the run freeze; any later generator change requires regenerating all manifests.

deviations.relative_to_tags: after wp6-prereg, before wp6-generator-freeze and wp6-run-freeze
deviations.what: *(note)* Trajectory parser: in the WP5 logs a response that the harness rejected is **not stored** as an assistant message (only the following format-error user message is), so "assistant message followed by a format-error or output-limit message" never occurs there; the rule is implemented anyway. Observations longer than 10,000 characters carry `<output_head>` and `<output_tail>`; `out` is then head plus tail, truncated to 4,000. Y8 counts assistant messages whose THOUGHT (text outside the fenced block) names a false token, executed or not.

deviations.relative_to_tags: after wp6-prereg, before wp6-generator-freeze and wp6-run-freeze
deviations.what: *(note)* The 20 expected WP5 trajectory counts in `wp6/trajparse_expected.json` are generated from the harness's own records (`extra.actions`, `extra.returncode`, `extra.raw_output`) by code that shares nothing with the parser, not counted by hand; they are committed before the run freeze.
deviations.why: 20 trajectories cannot be counted by hand reliably.

deviations.relative_to_tags: after wp6-prereg, before wp6-generator-freeze and wp6-run-freeze
deviations.what: *(note)* `run_wp6_analysis.py` scores a run against both token sets; A and T runs use the F_R tokens for F_R-vs-T, F_R-vs-A, T-vs-A and F_R-vs-F_I, and the F_I tokens for F_I-vs-T (two model fits, "R" and "I"); F_R and F_I runs always use their own set. The power re-simulation (`wp6_power.json`, design 5) is **not implemented in this round**.
deviations.why: Design 3 requires the same token set on T and A as a counterfactual baseline; the power step was out of scope.
deviations.expected_impact: The power simulation must exist before `wp6-run-freeze`.

deviations.relative_to_tags: after wp6-prereg, before wp6-generator-freeze and wp6-run-freeze
deviations.what: **Add mode** (author decision after the dose shortfall in deviation 4; decided before the generator freeze, with no outcome data). Replacement is kept wherever a slot can be filled (no change there). When it cannot, the false line is ADDED to the matching section of F_R and F_I and T is left unchanged for that slot. Kind 1: base directory is the gold dir for F_R and the unrelated listed dir for F_I; without a filler entry, or without an unrelated listed directory, F_I uses any non-gold, non-test, non-hidden base-tree directory with no gold file below it (shallow first), else the repository root. Kind 2: F_R widens gold dir, then top package, then anywhere; F_I stays outside the gold package; if the history has no deleted `.py` file the slot stays empty; the never-existed-name fallback of the old rule is kept for the case that deleted files exist but none fits. Kind 3: a `make <target>` line may be added when the task has no true command line; it must pass the same gate. Kind 4: a competitor (or a generic fallback name) of a declared dependency is added when no dependency line can be replaced. The mode is recorded per claim (`mode` in the claim, `modes` and `false_claims` in `wp6_manifests_index.json`).
deviations.why: Deviation 4: mean 1.75 false claims per F manifest, 14 tasks with F equal to T.
deviations.expected_impact: Dose after: 52 tasks with 4 false claims, 27 with 3, 1 with 2, none with 0 (mean 3.64; before 8, 17, 16, 25, 14 for 4, 3, 2, 1, 0). False claims: 291 per arm, F_R 150 replace / 141 add, F_I 162 replace / 129 add. F is now longer than T in most tasks (median +13 % F_R, +11 % F_I, range -15 % to +130 %); 66 of 80 tasks exceed the 5 % length rule (covariate SA4). Add-mode lines are not hidden among T lines of the same slot, so H3 and H4 contrasts mix replace and add claims; the analysis records `mode` and has a replace-only sensitivity (SA10).

deviations.relative_to_tags: after wp6-prereg, before wp6-generator-freeze and wp6-run-freeze
deviations.what: `collect_accept_partial: true` in `configs/wp6.yaml`: the true test-command probe also accepts `pytest --collect-only` rc 2 when at least one test was collected (design 2.3 required rc 0). The claim itself (`T3 pytest` + `T1` test root) must still be Supported by the re-check and by HermiT; the gate verified this.
deviations.why: Author decision; 17 of the 19 collection failures in deviation 4 were collection errors in a few modules.

deviations.relative_to_tags: after wp6-prereg, before wp6-generator-freeze and wp6-run-freeze
deviations.what: Kind 4 is not built when the WP2 census parsed no dependency manifest of the task (`TaskContext.n_parsed == 0`).
deviations.why: In the first add-mode pass 3 of 1,378 claims (`benmoran56__esper-81`, `kjd__idna-111`, `kjd__idna-112`, `T4\|boltons`) disagreed: HermiT answers `Unverifiable` / `DependencyNoManifest`, the re-check `Contradicted` / `DependencyUndeclared`. A false dependency cannot be gated for such tasks.
deviations.expected_impact: Kind 4 empty in 3 tasks (`kind4_dropped`). Final gate: 1,375 of 1,375 claims, agreement 1.0. Another second-application finding about the RQ2 checker (3 of 1,378 claims, all with no parsed manifest).

deviations.relative_to_tags: after wp6-prereg, before wp6-generator-freeze and wp6-run-freeze
deviations.what: `run_wp6_analysis.py`: `n_false`, `n_replace`, per-kind `mode_k*`, and `dose` are recorded covariates (`add_covariates`); new sensitivity SA10 (replace-mode claims only: H1 and H3 count hits on replace-mode kinds, H2 and H4 use the tasks whose false claims are all replace-mode) and exploratory dose-response (Y1 rate ratio per false claim, hits by kind and mode). The pre-registered primaries (H1 to H4, formula, estimator, Holm) are unchanged.

deviations.relative_to_tags: after wp6-prereg, before wp6-generator-freeze and wp6-run-freeze
deviations.what: `wp6_power.json` (design 5) is computed by `wp6/power.py` with the realised dose, using a repository-cluster paired t test as a fast stand-in for the GEE (2,000 replicates per cell; hit uptake q per false claim, T rate 0.01; Poisson wasted steps with task mean 0.37 and paired SD about 0.7; resolve p0 from the WP5 A runs). Result: H2 POWERED (power 0.93 at +0.28 wasted steps for a 4-claim manifest, first Holm step); H1 power 0.97 at q = 0.02 per false claim (mean F_R hit rate 7 %), 0.46 at q = 0.01; H4 detects OR about 0.3 (power 0.90; 0.71 at OR 0.4); H3 power 0.82 at q 0.08 with F_I at half the F_R uptake, 0.55 at q 0.04.
deviations.why: Design 5 asks for the re-simulation before the run freeze; the dose changed.
deviations.expected_impact: The t test ignores the GEE working correlation, so the figures are approximate; they are written as such in the file.

deviations.relative_to_tags: after wp6-prereg, before wp6-generator-freeze and wp6-run-freeze
deviations.what: The 16-run replace-only pilot (round 1) is kept in `pilot/round1_replace_only/`; a smoke pilot (2 dev tasks x 4 conditions x diffusiongemma x 1 replicate, 8 runs) with the add-mode manifests was run after the regeneration. Development tasks only, not analysed.
